data.name: Wraith
data.detailed_description:
Fight the Wraith as you struggle to survive in various environments using a real-time marketplace and currency system that allows you to purchase weapons, add-ons, ammunition, recharge your flashlight battery and more.

You can select from various maps that range from night maps, day-time maps, a snow/blizzard map and more. All of our maps feature a dynamic lighting system that will challenge you by darkening the experience over time as the Wraith become stronger and the sun sets on the horizon.



Experience increasing difficulty as different types of Wraith begin to appear over time; watch as they crawl out of the ground to kill you with an overall increase in health as the game progresses. Test yourself or your friends in the ultimate survival experience developed by one person for all.

How long can you last?

MAPS AVAILABLE:
  • The Camp
  • The Path
  • Sunset
  • Blizzard

We'd love to hear your feedback!
You can leave us a review with suggestions. We look forward to implementing any cool ideas you may have.

reviews.review:
[h1] I played this on the Oculus Rift with Touch controllers [/h1]

So, in all honesty, I did have fun in this game.  But in essence, it's just an endless 360 wave shooter.  If some small changes were made, it would be a very good wave shooter.  But as it stands now, it is just a very mediocre wave shooter.  I don't see much replayability, although it's a good game to showcase VR to friends or family.

[h1] PROS [/h1]
+ very good looking maps and there's 4 of them
+ very good use of light and dark and fog (usually gets darker after each wave)
+ nice ambient sounds
+ guns are pretty accurate and they each play differently, although would have preferred to have to 2hand shotgun
+ when you're dying, the screen starts turning red, it's harder to see, and you feel your heart beating = tense moments
+/- easy reloads, but could have been just a little bit more realistic

[h1] CONS [/h1]
- no story, no real progression, no leaderboards, just wave after wave
- only saw three different enemy models, didn't notice any difference other than I think one took more bullets to kill maybe and one of the enemy models spawns from the ground, they all run straight towards you
- no real strategy 
- didn't notice any audible clues of where enemies where coming from, except when it's too late (they are pummeling you)
- UI feels clunky, from the main menu, to buying upgrades in the quickbuy (took several tries to buy things)
-/+ gun sounds could have been better, they were just okay, didn't sound realistic

So how could this game be a lot better?  Well for starters, it needs more enemy types.  For example, adding crows that hide in trees that you have to kill to slow down the number of enemy spawns coming towards you.  Have mage wraiths that shoot fireballs at you that you have to avoid.  Slower and faster moving wraiths (slower being harder to kill than the faster ones).  Wraiths that explode.  

How about all the wraiths make sounds when they spawn and walk towards you?  Audible cues to their location would have been awesome and that way you could make the nights even darker.  Also make the flashlight more useful.  Not until it got very dark, did I ever feel the need to turn it on.  Adding flares would also be a nice touch.

Also, clean up the UI and the quickbuy store.  Make it easy to make upgrades.  Let us know how much ammo we have total (not just in the gun).  Leaderboards, we need them for bragging rights.  

Sale Price Raiting 5.5/10 Just barely worth the sale price, I would not recommend this game at full price, there's just so little content and the gameplay gets repetitive fast, despite the pretty environmental graphics
